map.→ 打开响片时机练习器工具: -> Open the sound clip timing practice tool
map.不同难度档（间隔 0.5–4 秒）渐进练习，缩短行为出现到点击的延迟，提升标记精: Progressive practice across difficulty tiers (intervals 0.5–4 seconds) shortens the delay from behaviour onset to click and improves marking precision.
map.响片声需精确标记正确行为发生的瞬间；行为出现后 1–2 秒内响片宠物尚可关联，但: The click must precisely mark the moment the correct behaviour occurs; a click within 1–2 seconds of the behaviour can still be associated, but within 200ms is the most accurate. This trainer replaces the real behaviour with a visual green dot to train finger reaction speed so that marking is more accurate in real training.
map.响片时机练习器 使用指南: Sound clip timing practice tool user guide
map.太早点击或错过会怎样？: What happens if you click too early or too late?
map.太早（绿点未亮就点）会标记到“等待”而非行为；错过（红点已现）则标记到行为结束甚: Clicking too early (before the green dot lights) marks a "wait" rather than the behaviour; clicking too late (the red dot has appeared) marks the end of the behaviour or even the next action. Both confuse the pet about which behaviour the click means, so repeated calibration against the recorded history is needed.
map.正式训练前用绿点游戏热身，把“行为出现瞬间按下响片”的手指反应练到 300ms: Before formal training, warm up with the green dot game until the finger reaction for pressing the click at the moment the behaviour appears is under 300ms.
map.记录每次反应时间与命中率，定位自己常在“太早”还是“错过”上失误，针对性改进。: Record every reaction time and hit rate to see whether you err on "too early" or "too late" and target your improvement.
map.这是一个响片训练计时练习小游戏：屏幕随机亮起绿灯，训练者在绿色点亮的瞬间立即点击: This is a click-timing trainer for marker training: the screen lights a green light at random and the trainer clicks the clicker the instant it lights, and the tool records the marking delay, hit rate and average reaction time to help dog trainers sharpen their timing.
map.：绿点亮起=行为出现，红点=行为消失。点击延迟 280ms 落在 <350ms: : the green dot lighting means the behaviour appeared, the red dot means it ended. A 280ms click delay falls in the "excellent" band below 350ms (<200ms perfect, <500ms good, <800ms average). The training target is an average reaction under 300ms, where the click precisely marks the moment the behaviour occurs so the pet builds the right association; delays over 1 second may mark the wrong behaviour.
